name: Iowa State Cross Country Championships
headline: Iowa State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Pella won the Class 3A girls with 34 points (Des Moines Christian 127), while Mount Vernon-Lisbon's Evelyn Moeller won the individual title in 17:07.5; Gilbert took the 3A boys at 98 points over Sioux Center (114) behind Logan Bleich's 15:12.2. In 4A, Dowling Catholic won the boys title with 70 points over Cedar Falls (93) and Marshalltown's Preston Johnson won in 14:40.2, and Cedar Falls edged Ankeny Centennial 96-101 for the girls title with Cedar Falls' Charlee Gall winning in 17:13.0. In the small classes, Pella Christian won 2A boys (62) with Chariton's Lucas Anderson first in 15:57.3, Mid-Prairie Wellman won 2A girls (85) with Monticello's Mary Grace Lyons first in 18:06.6, Riverside Oakland won 1A boys on a tiebreaker over Earlham after both scored 127 (Tri-Center Neola's Haven Weers won in 15:57.4), and Maquoketa Valley Delhi won 1A girls with 54 points (Madrid's Madelyn Grothus won in 18:17.6).
